title: add-prompt-fuzz-prober-and-sensitivity-scorer-ci-gate
author: Maya Chen
description: Add a CI-first prompt sensitivity probe (fuzz-prober) and a sensitivity scorer that can be gated in CI. Motivation: many prompt regressions are preceded by brittle behavior where small input perturbations cause large output deltas; this hook runs stochastic perturbations (token edits, paraphrase sampling, placeholder masking) against prompt sets and computes a sensitivity score. If sensitivity exceeds a threshold for a cohort, the CI gate flags the run and fails the build. The PR contains: fuzz-prober library, sensitivity scorer, a CI adapter for the eval-harness CI hooks manager, unit/integration tests, a small failure replay harness, and docs + runbook. Checklist: - implement fuzz-prober and tuning harness - add sensitivity scoring and aggregation to eval-metrics - wire gate into ci/hooks registry with opt-in flag in project configs - add deterministic seed mode for CI runs - add unit/integration tests and flaky mitigation - document behaviour and operational runbook. Related items: ENG-1982 (prompt robustness initiative), ENG-2001 (ci hooks consolidation), support ticket SUP-4312 for customer-reported prompt regressions. Notes: default gate is opt-in for existing prompt sets; migration/backfill guidance added in docs.

review_thread: Diego Ramirez (reviewer): This is a very helpful tool for catching brittle prompts. Two asks: 1) make CI runs deterministic by default so the gate is stable; 2) include an explanation in the docs for how thresholds are derived. Requested changes.
Maya Chen (author): Added deterministic-seed mode and documented threshold derivation in docs. Kept stochastic mode available behind flag for local stress testing.

Linnea Kaur (reviewer): Observability note: please emit per-cohort histograms to the metrics backend so we can visualize sensitivity distributions over time. Also add a soft-fail mode to avoid blocking emergency rollouts.
Maya Chen (author): Added histogram metric and a soft-fail configuration option. CI gate default is fail for opt-in prompt sets and soft-fail for global opt-out migration sets.
Samir Patel (reviewer): Integration test flaky on first run; saw one timeout in the replay harness. Please add retry guard and a shorter default timeout for CI. Approve after fix.
Maya Chen (author): Increased retry and reduced external network dependency in the integration test. Reran tests; CI green. Marking as ready to merge.
checks_summary: integration tests: initial run failed due to timeout on replay harness; rerun passed
release_notes: Adds a prompt fuzz prober and sensitivity scoring CI hook that can be opt-in per prompt set. Provides a new metric (sensitivity_score) and runbook for diagnosing brittle prompts. No breaking changes to existing eval APIs; gate is opt-in.
notes: Gate is opt-in by default. Teams should run backfill with provided replay tool before enabling for wide cohorts. Thresholds were tuned using three internal prompt-set pilots and are documented in the runbook.
